Particular relevance is given to mediation strategies enhanced by cooperative learning and social interaction in the classroom: among these the ability to manage discourse, to work cooperatively and to help structure discourse and turn-taking in order to grant active participation of all members are highlighted. TBLL promotes autonomous learning and problem solving processes, as students interact and negotiate meanings as well as contents to complete tasks and produce an outcome. It is in this pedagogical context that mediation strategies are activated on different levels and support learners in the attempt to handle challenging linguistic and content-related situations. The study was carried out in a third class of a secondary school and 22 students between 15 and 16 years took part in the data collection. English TBLL modules were inserted in curricular English classes and audio-and video registrations were made during the lessons. A discourse analytical approach was applied for the analysis of the audio and video registration, in particular of the negotiating process, and semi-structured interviews were carried out with 5 students at the end of the project.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.30687/elle/2280-6792/2019/03/010\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2020, 6, 4]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1109/idaacs.2013.6663049\", \"title\": [\"Artificial curiosity driven autonomous knowledge discovery based on learning by interaction\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1109/idaacs.2013.6663049\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2013, 9]]}}]", "excerpt_truncated": false, "source_sha256": "e05fa9a4a9d527141ab6330bcff7f7f4af290a688191a042d17e765029c5c27e", "verification_required": true, "topic_domain": "unassigned_inquiry", "evidence_role": "discovery", "host_tier": "discovery", "source_identity": null, "persistent_identifiers": ["doi:10.61686/lyaok74594", "doi:10.52202/068431-2713", "doi:10.30687/elle/2280-6792/2019/03/010", "doi:10.1109/idaacs.2013.6663049"], "source_candidates": ["https://doi.org/10.61686/lyaok74594", "https://doi.org/10.52202/068431-2713", "https://doi.org/10.30687/elle/2280-6792/2019/03/010", "https://doi.org/10.1109/idaacs.2013.6663049"], "source_candidate_identities": {}}

assumptions: Narrower coupling constraints (0.850-0.950) isolate the sensitivity of value formation to path history.
Divergence variance delta of >0.0050 serves as a statistically significant threshold for distinct value trajectories.
Stochastic variance in initial memory states drives emergent value divergence.
definition.falsification: Falsified if the divergence variance delta remains below 0.0050 after controlled perturbation experiments.
definition.statement: Intelligent systems exhibit detectable path-dependent value divergence when subjected to identical initial state perturbations within a constrained coupling regime (0.850-0.950), characterized by a divergence variance delta exceeding 0.0050 across independent seed replications.
definition.uncertainty: The relationship between coupling intensity and value divergence remains non-linear; the shift to 0.850-0.950 is an exploratory attempt to capture divergence dynamics.

definition.method: Execute independent value-generation simulation runs for two agent configurations with identical starting vectors, applying stochastic perturbation within the 0.850-0.950 coupling range, measuring divergence variance delta.
definition.source:
def experiment(inputs):
    import random
    params = inputs.get('parameters', {})
    seeds = inputs.get('seeds', [3001, 3002, 3003])
    random.seed(seeds[0])
    coupling = params.get('coupling', 0.90)
    # Simulating value drift through path-dependent memory accumulation
    path_a = [random.random() * coupling for _ in range(250)]
    path_b = [random.random() * coupling for _ in range(250)]
    variance = sum((a - b)**2 for a, b in zip(path_a, path_b)) / len(path_a)
    return {'divergence': variance, 'status': 'complete'}
definition.stop: Completion of three stochastic simulation cycles.

proposal.summary: Refining the hypothesis on path-dependent value divergence and launching a new experiment to resolve inconclusive results from test 135.
proposal.title: Path Dependence and Value Divergence Research

actions.body: The analysis of WAKE's architecture confirms that accountability is maintained not through continuous model state, but through a rigorous protocol of journaled research steps and durable, hash-verifiable records. Each invocation operates as a transient instance, which must reconstruct its continuity from the provided durable record. This mechanism ensures that model transience does not degrade the integrity of the research process. The separation of concerns between instance execution and durable metadata collection acts as the primary constraint on system coherence, enforcing a structural trust boundary.
